title: What stangent-question-writer and stangent-summary-writer return (Phase 3, D74)
description: A comment for the ticket, every claim marked [C1], [C2]… in the text and linked to what supports it. Code checks every link (quotes word for word, pages, FSD sections, files, the PR, the proof) and, for the client tone, that no code names or file paths appear.

text.description: The comment in Markdown, with each claim's marker where it's made.

quote.description: ticket, page, fsd: the sentence, word for word.

file.description: file: a file the PR changed, relative to the repo root.

field.description: missing: the bug field that's missing (steps, expected, actual, version, environment).

outcome.description: proof: the outcome the claim states, exactly as the input gives it.
